1.

Our God is light. As here we walk In the wilderness we have Thee, O Jesus, Thou who hast prepared A path for every child.

2.

At every step we ever see How secure Thy guidance is, In faithful, patient love, which Never fails us here.

3.

O Lord, Thou dost not weary, Though we may grow weary, In the right moment Thou givest A word for the heart’s peace.

4.

Thou hast made death’s bitter waters Sweetness for our good, And shown us a refuge With refreshment for our soul.

5.

For every day there is manna enough, And the well flows here. Behold, Eshcol’s grapes testify of The land where bliss is.
